identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to download a payload from a rare domain and execute it, triggering the 'Abnormal Communication to a Rare Domain' alert. Cortex should detect the PowerShell process spawning a network connection to an uncommon domain.

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process starts with hidden window

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: PowerShell Download and Execute Rare Domain
biocs.description: Detection of PowerShell downloading and executing a file from a rare domain
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'malware.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'

abiocs.name: Abnormal Communication to Rare Domain
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation indicating communication to a rare domain not seen in historical data
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'
| filter action_remote_hostname = '192.0.2.100'
| comp count() as events by action_remote_ip, agent_hostname
| sort desc events

xql_queries.name: Rare Domain Network Connections
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'
| comp count() as events by action_remote_ip, agent_hostname
| sort desc events
